_note: All rects are [x,y,w,h] and points [x,y], normalised 0-1 to the image they belong to. Generated by [assets].

imac._screenQuad: glass corners TL,TR,BR,BL (the iMac is at a 3/4 angle, so the glass is a perspective quad; 'screen' is its bounding box)
imac._slot: centre of the slot-loading CD slot on imac-front; slotWidth is its length as a fraction of image width
imac._trayDisc: centre of the disc well on the open tray in imac-tray-open (same canvas/crop as imac-front, crossfade between them)

studio._how: LAYERED WIDE SHOT on one 1672x941 canvas. Draw in order: bg -> visitor (optional) -> host + sameep sprite frames at their 'box' -> deskFg at its box. All boxes [x,y,w,h] normalised to the canvas. Sprites/visitor sit BEHIND the desk; the desk-fg (desk top, front panel, mugs, papers, lava lamp, cassette, can, glass, headphones) occludes them. Locked camera; life = mouth flaps + blinks.

visitor._: place img/characters/<id>.webp (square) centred at cx with its bottom edge at 'bottom'; side length = height x canvas height. Draw it BEFORE deskFg so the desk hides the waist. At this size the shoulders end just left of the small desk mic. Verified in build/qa/v2-composite-visitor.png.

medium._: medium shot = viewport into the same layered canvas (render bg+sprites+fg, crop to box, scale to fill). med-*.webp are flattened 1280x720 stills of that crop (closed mouth) for fallback.

closeup._: full-frame opaque 1672x941 close-ups, 4 aligned frames each: img/sprites/<who>/cu-{closed,mid,open,blink}.webp

insert._: item-card insert: hands hold a CD; card drawn top-left in Doto (title Black ~58px@1672w, cream #f3eee2, ember ▾ #ffa946; fields Doto Bold ~34px, key cream 65% / value ember). insert-plate is the same shot without the card so the app can render live cards in HTML.

host._looks: side = facing the other seat (closed..blink); front-* = same seat, looking into the camera. All 12 frames share box/canvas; only head (front) or mouth/eyes differ. Close-ups use cu-front-* (cu-* side set kept as fallback).
host.mouthShapes: closed < mid < open < wide by loudness; oo = rounded vowel variant; blink = eyes shut, mouth closed

sameep._looks: side = facing the other seat (closed..blink); front-* = same seat, looking into the camera. All 12 frames share box/canvas; only head (front) or mouth/eyes differ. Close-ups use cu-front-* (cu-* side set kept as fallback).
sameep.mouthShapes: closed < mid < open < wide by loudness; oo = rounded vowel variant; blink = eyes shut, mouth closed

host-k56._: a visitor-picked host (episode.json hosts) in the host seat: still frames with drawn mouth shapes, lip-synced from data/visemes.json; no talking-video bank yet

host-gus._: a visitor-picked host (episode.json hosts) in the host seat: still frames with drawn mouth shapes, lip-synced from data/visemes.json; no talking-video bank yet

audio._loops: fire-loop (8.0s) and bed-loop (45.7s, 84bpm, 16 bars) loop seamlessly; bed is mastered at -23 LUFS to sit under voice

cutaways._: 16:9 1672x941 opaque vignette cards; mark a line with "cutaway":"img/cutaways/<id>.webp"
